pie: h₂óweyes ḱunéy skʷént. ḱwón nos péh₂si poh₂imḗn nos h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m skinédti. ḱwṓ wérh₁t. péh₂smi wos méne moy pótnih₂ misdʰóm dédeh₃ti. h₂óweyes h₂ǵént. téwe nos misdʰós h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂. nu ḱwṓ ne bʰéh₂t.
english: The sheep said to the dog: "Dog, you guard us. The shepherd cuts off our wool." The dog said: "I guard you. My mistress gives me a wage." The sheep said: "Your wage is our wool." Then the dog was not speaking.

pie: gʷm̥yéti h₁íh₂m̥-kʷe kʷis ne wédʰeti. h₂éǵrom ḱóymom-kʷe ḱéleti. sóh₂wl̥ h₁ésyeh₂s ḱéletor. kʷíd h₁íd? nókʷts.
english: It comes, and no one leads it. It covers the field and the home. The sun hides from it. What is it? Night.

pie: dwóh₁ moysóh₁ pr̥wéni gʷm̥tā́m. moysós h₂éǵt. móyse h₂pó gʷh₂dʰí h₁eǵóh₂ pró yéh₂mi. h₁énos moysós wérh₁t. túH h₂pó gʷh₂dʰí h₁eǵóh₂ pró yéh₂mi. nu stundtā́m dwóh₁ moysóh₁ sruméni-kʷe ní gʷh₂tā́m. nu sréwmn̥ pró h₁éyt.
english: Two rams arrived at a rock. A ram said: "Go away, ram. I go on." That ram said: "You go away. I go on." Then the two rams pushed, and both went down into the stream. Then the stream flowed on.

pie: kʷíd swésor gʷm̥sḱéti swóm-kʷe stérh₃mn̥ ne linkʷtés. tód dʰǵʰmés gʷm̥yéti. ǵʰwḗres h₁íd píph₃onti. kʷíd h₁íd? sréwmn̥.
english: "Sister, what goes and does not leave its bed? It comes from the earth. Beasts drink it. What is it?" A stream.

pie: owis eḱwobʰyos eweket, "ḱerd angʰetai moi widontei ǵʰm̥onm̥ eḱwons aǵontm̥."
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: h₂éwis tn̥tlóy h₃sléydʰt. nu gʷémt ǵʰwḗr. h₂éwis wéwket. ǵʰwḗr me spr̥dʰí. déh₃rom toy déh₃oh₂. nu ǵʰwḗr tn̥tlóm skélHt h₁íh₂m̥-kʷe spért. nu légʰt ǵʰwḗr. nu wiHrós h₁ért. nu h₂éwis wiHróm kʷéḱt HréwdHt-kʷe. nu ǵʰwḗr bʰéwdʰt bʰéwgt-kʷe. h₂éwis wérh₁yet. déh₃rom toy déh₃wm̥.
english: A bird slipped into a net. Then a beast came. The bird said: "Beast, free me. I shall give you a gift." Then the beast slit the net and freed her. Then the beast lay down. Then a man came. Then the bird saw the man and cried out. Then the beast woke and fled. The bird said: "I gave you a gift."

pie: h₁yód poh₂imḗn légʰeti kʷís gʰóstey bʰéwdʰeti? só poh₂imnéy lewbʰós. só gʰostéyey dusménēs. gʰóstis wérh₁t. ḱwṓ bʰéwdʰeti.
english: When the shepherd lies down, who is awake, stranger? He is dear to the shepherd and ill-disposed to the stranger. The stranger said: "The dog is awake."

pie: wl̥kʷih₂bʰós swósyo ḱóymosyo dʰwóri légʰyet. nu gʷémt moysós. séh₂ wérh₁t. móyse h₂énti gʷm̥yé méroh₂-wē. polh₁ú gʷéh₂mn̥ téwe ḱóymom yéh₂ti. h₁ésmōd kʷid h₁éǵʰs gʷm̥sḱéti. h₂énti mē gʷm̥yṓh₂. nu moysós léytt wl̥kʷíh₂s-kʷe légʰyet tr̥syét-kʷe.
english: A she-wolf lay at the door of her own home. Then a ram came. She said: "Ram, come near, or I shall die." "Many steps go to your home. Nothing goes out of it. I shall not come near." Then the ram went away, and the she-wolf lay and thirsted.

pie: h₂éwsōs wr̥ǵyóntey h₂n̥réy péḱos déh₃ut. h₂éwsōs str̥h₃méni ḱéym̥h₁nōy suHnówey péḱos ne déh₃ut. h₂wést. h₂nér sth₂dʰí.
english: Dawn gives wealth to the man who works. Dawn gives no wealth to the son lying in bed. It has dawned. Rise, man!

pie: h₂éwis h₂ébolm̥ bʰéret. nu moysós h₁íh₂m̥ kʷéḱt wérh₁yet moysós. téwe wékʷos h₁wésu. bʰh₂dʰí moy. nu h₂éwis HréwdHt h₂ébōl-kʷe h₃sléydʰt. nu moysós h₁ím h₂éḱh₃t. h₂éwis h₂éǵt. wékʷos ḱlḗm. nu h₂ébōl lelóykʷe.
english: A bird was carrying an apple. Then a ram saw her. The ram said: "Your word is good. Speak to me." Then the bird cried out, and the apple slipped. Then the ram ate it up. The bird said: "I heard a word. Now the apple is gone."

pie: h₂ówis tu h₁eḱwoibʰ(y)os weukʷét, "ḱḗr Hegʰnutór moi h₁éḱwons Héǵontm̥ Hnérm̥ widn̥tbʰ(y)os."
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: h₂egʷnós pr̥wéni stestóh₂e h₂éwim-kʷe upér widét. só wérh₁yet. h₂éwey úd yéh₂si úd-kʷe h₁éyoh₂. méne me pornéh₂ wéǵʰeti. dʰǵʰémi gʷm̥sḱé. h₁eǵóh₂ dyéwi yéh₂mi. nu h₂egʷnós h₁íh₂m̥ ne ḱléwt pr̥wéns-kʷe h₃sléydʰt.
english: A lamb was standing on a rock and saw a bird above. He said: "Bird, you go up, and I shall go up." "My wings carry me. Walk on the earth. I go in the sky." Then the lamb did not hear her, and slipped from the rock.

pie: kʷíd népot h₂nḗr dédeh₃ti h₁íd-kʷe kapyéte. népōts h₂éǵt. h₂nḗr wékʷos dédeh₃ti h₁íd-kʷe kapyéti.
english: Grandson, what does a man give and hold? The grandson said: "A man gives a word, and holds it."

pie: h₂éngʷʰis h₂ówim h₁r̥sḱét. sékʷt. h₂ówey toy méne h₁óytom h₁opéyetes. mē te moréyōh₂. séh₂ mléwHt. h₂éngʷʰey téwe h₁óytos dʰuh₂mós. litdʰí. ḱwṓ bʰebʰówdʰe.
english: A snake came to a sheep. He said: "Sheep, I give you my oath. I shall not kill you." She said: "Snake, your oath is smoke. Go away! The dog is on the alert."

pie: h₁éy wésni h₂wékst h₁rudʰéh₁ti-kʷe. pótnih₂ wiHrṓy h₁ím h₁opéyeti. kʷís h₁éy? h₂ébōl.
english: It grew in spring, and it is red. The mistress gives it to the man. What is it? An apple.

pie: légʰyonts poh₂imḗn wĺ̥kʷom h₂életi. bʰéwdʰonts ḱwṓ h₂ówins h₂lékseti. h₁yód ḱwṓ bʰebʰówdʰe. wĺ̥kʷos h₂ówins ne h₁ḗdti.
english: A shepherd lying down feeds the wolf. A dog that is awake guards the sheep. If the dog is on the alert, the wolf does not eat the sheep.

pie: wĺ̥kʷos h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂h₁ woséyeto h₂ówins-kʷe h₁r̥sḱét. nu moysós dénḱtreh₂ widét. wéwket moysós. h₂óweyes spéḱyete. h₁énos ne h₂ówis. h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂ wésmn̥ dénḱtrom swóm. nu wĺ̥kʷos bʰéyh₂t bʰéwgt-kʷe. h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂ wĺ̥kʷom ḱéleti dénḱtrom-kʷe h₁ím woydéyeti.
english: A wolf clothed himself in wool and went to the sheep. Then the ram saw the fangs. The ram said: "Sheep, look! That is no sheep. The wool is a garment; the fang is his own." Then the wolf became afraid and fled. The wool hides the wolf, and the fang shows him.

pie: h₂éwis pr̥wéni sédyet. nu sérpet h₂éngʷʰis h₁íd. h₂éwis sékʷt. h₂éngʷʰey kúdʰe sérpesi? só wérh₁t. h₂isḱóh₂ te h₁wésu toy wékʷos bʰéroh₂. h₂éwis wéwket. h₂éngʷʰey me dʰrugʰyési. nu h₂éwis bʰéwgt h₂éngʷʰis-kʷe pr̥wéni légʰt.
english: A bird was sitting on a rock. Then a snake came creeping to it. The bird said: "Snake, where are you creeping?" He said: "I seek you. I bring you a good word." The bird said: "You deceive me, snake." Then the bird fled, and the snake lay down on the rock.

pie: ménos pró h₁éyti ǵʰóstom-kʷe sékʷetor. téwe ǵʰóstos pró mē dr̥myéh₁t.
english: The mind goes forward, and the hand follows. May your hand not run ahead.

pie: wódr̥ pérwr̥ h₂n̥réh₁ ne térdt. h₂yúh₁ térdt. sruméns h₁ukdʰí.
english: Water does not bore the rock by force. By long time it bores through. Learn from the stream.

pie: kʷís h₂éǵroy sédyeti? séh₂ úd h₁éyti. h₁íh₂m̥ kʷis ǵʰóstoh₁ ne kapyéti. h₁yód h₂éwsōs h₁éreti séh₂ HréwdHti. ph₂ter ǵn̥h₃dʰí. ph₂tḗr sékʷt. h₁íh₂ h₂éwis.
english: Who sits in the field? She goes up. No one holds her in the hand. When dawn arrives, she cries out. Guess, father! The father said: "It is a bird."

pie: bʰréh₂terh₁e dówsih₁. bʰréh₂tēr bʰréh₂term̥ h₂lékseti. h₁ím ne dʰrugʰyéti. swésōr bʰréh₂trey lewbʰéh₂.
english: Two brothers are two arms. A brother protects a brother. He does not deceive him. A sister is dear to her brother.

pie: polh₁éwes péḱesi lewbʰṓs. lewbʰós h₂égʰesi ǵn̥nh₃tór. wíHre lewbʰóm mē dʰrugʰyés.
english: In wealth many are dear. In distress the dear one is known. Do not deceive your dear one.

pie: kʷís ph₂wéns ǵn̥h₁yétor ḱóymōd-kʷe úd h₁éyti. h₁ím kʷis ǵʰóstoh₁ ne kapyéti. dʰuh₂mós.
english: Who is born of fire and goes up from the home? No one holds him in the hand. Smoke.

pie: h₁yód dʰuh₂mós h₁ésti péh₂wr̥ h₁ésti. dʰuh₂mós ḱóymōd úd gʷm̥sḱéti. péh₂wr̥ ne ḱéletor.
english: If there is smoke, there is fire. Smoke comes up from the home. Fire does not hide itself.

pie: kʷís wiHrṓy wésmn̥ dédeh₃ti gʷíh₃weti-kʷe. h₂éǵros h₁íh₂m̥ h₂életi. poh₂imḗn h₁íh₂m̥ péh₂sti. h₂ówis.
english: Who gives a garment to the man and lives? The field feeds her. The shepherd guards her. A sheep.

pie: deywós wérunos diwés km̥tá gʷah₂t.
english: The god Werunos came down from heaven.

pie: kʷíd swésor h₁ḗdti ne-kʷe pléh₁dʰeti. kʷíd wódr̥ píph₃eti mért-kʷe. swésōr wéwket. péh₂wr̥ h₁ḗdti ne-kʷe pléh₁dʰeti. wódr̥ píph₃eti mért-kʷe.
english: "Sister, what eats and does not become full? What drinks water and dies?" The sister said: "Fire eats and does not become full. It drinks water and dies."
